text:
Alex: ok team meet Iggy — our rescue green iguana — finally nailed a sunlamp selfie :sunglasses:  pic: https://imgur.com/IGGYsun1 
Sam: omg those scales are neon :heart_eyes: who knew reptiles could glow like that
Cleo: 10/10 camouflage fail. needs tiny sunglasses for scale. :sunglasses: also is that a toe bean??
Nina: so good. quick q — what's your lamp schedule? worried about overheating if Iggy goes full sunbathing mode
Alex: we do 2x20min in the morning + 1x30min mid-afternoon. basking spot ~95°F, ambient ~78°F. heater is an old ceramic one that still does the job. for nerds, here's the schedule I pasted into the thermostat: 
```json
{"morning": ["08:00","00:20"], "afternoon": ["14:00","00:30"]}
```
Sam: LOL "old ceramic" is giving me so much energy. iguana priorities > gear aesthetics :joy:
OpsBot: Reminder: Pet Photo Friday at 3pm in #random — bring your critters! :paw_prints:
Cleo: Iggy demands a salad bar and a runway. more pics pls, alex. also vote: tiny sunglasses or tiny bandana? :eyes:
Alex: tiny sunglasses for Thrift Store Glam, bandana for Picnic Vibes. will post a slow-mo of Iggy tongue-flicking in ~10 that shows his "mustache" 
Nina: voting sunglasses. also can you share if he's good with people? thinking of bringing my niece to the demo :slightly_smiling_face:
Alex: super gentle with hands but slow — will be fine for a quiet meet-and-greet. i'll DM care tips.
Cleo: excited. if anyone has tiny craft supplies i'm volunteering to make accessories. iguana couture incoming. :sparkles:
Sam: can't wait. this thread makes my Monday. :thumbsup:
